mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend over 20-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative in 60%+ of instances where FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) exceeds its 12-month moving average and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 3.0%, the market prices a soft landing scenario, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative in 60%+ of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases (indicated by strong industrial production growth and low unemployment), the market anticipates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strengthening economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST trend over 5-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day returns are negative in 60%+ of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 4.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve will implement aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150k) coupled with weak retail sales (RSAFS < 500000 million dollars) indicates an overheating labor market without consumer demand, signaling potential recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (when FEDFUNDS is rising above 3.0% and inflation is elevated), the market prices in higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.
